programme.desc: The remaining 12 have nine rounds and 27 challenges to get through before they are crowned Winner. Having survived cake, they now battle bread.

programme.desc: Having survived cake and bread, the remaining 11 bakers now face desserts. In this round the bakers have to multi-task across several different baking skills.

programme.title: Great British Baking Show

programme.title: Great British Baking Show
programme.desc: Almost halfway through the competition, the remaining eight bakers are faced with biscuits and traybakes. They also take on the French classic tuiles.

programme.title: Great British Baking Show
programme.desc: It's time for sweet dough week, but will it prove bittersweet for the bakers? They start with a signature tea loaf, while the Showstopper involves 36 European buns.

programme.title: Great British Baking Show
programme.desc: The six remaining bakers face a series of pastry-based challenges. They bring suet pudding up to date, tackle religieuse and make three different types of puffed pastries.

programme.title: Great British Baking Show
programme.desc: The five remaining bakers must cope with unconventional flours and unusual desserts, designed to push their creativity to the max.

programme.title: Great British Baking Show
programme.desc: It is the semi-final and there are just four bakers left. This time it is the French round, and the challenges include savoury canapes and opera cake.

programme.title: Great British Baking Show
programme.desc: The finalists face three last challenges designed to demonstrate how much the amateur bakers have grown in skill and creativity, before the winner is announced.

programme.title: Great British Baking Show
